test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

She was known for her __refined__ manners.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"refined"** means something that is elegant, cultured, or polite. (शिष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **Her refined taste in art was evident from her collection.
 
 
 
• **"Crude"** refers to something that is raw, unrefined, or lacking in culture and manners. (अशिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His crude behavior at the dinner party was embarrassing for everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'refined'** is **'crude'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elegant** (शानदार): Tastefully fine or luxurious in dress, style, design, etc.

 
 
• **Example:** She wore an elegant gown to the ball.
 
 
 
• **Brood** (गहन चिंतन): To think deeply about something that makes one unhappy.
 
 
• **Example:** He would often brood over his past mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Shrewd** (चतुर): Having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute.
 
 
• **Example:** Her shrewd business tactics earned her a fortune.
